bio.text: Frances Holk-Jones, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 95 since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot after advancing from the June 16, 2026 Republican primary runoff.
She was born in Baldwin County, Alabama.
Her career experience includes working as president of Frances Holk Insurance Inc., and she co-founded the Jennifer Claire Moore Foundation.
